# internal/tasks property tests that dominate the package under -race (2273 s
# in default r3 before the split; CapRun ~573 s, MultiHandle ~130 s, Reservation
# >300 s, the two SessionTree property tests 152 s and 147 s measured
# locally under -race). They run in their own shards "Test shard (default tp1)" and
# "(default tp2)" (go test -run) and every other shard skips them (go test -skip), so
# each runs exactly once. One line per test: "Name shard" (tp1 ~700 s, tp2 ~650 s
# locally); '#' lines ignored.
# tasks-heavy-tests_test.sh checks the names exist, are unique repo-wide, and
# that -run plus -skip cover the package exactly once.
TestCapRunPropertyInvariants tp1
TestReservationPropertyInvariants tp2
TestCapRunMultiHandleInvariants tp1
TestSessionTreeCeilingProperty tp2
TestSessionTreeLegalOpsAreAcceptedProperty tp2
